question: Who was the first President of Constituent Assembly of independent India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr Rajendra Prasad**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajendra Prasad was elected as the first President of India on 24th January 1950 and the vice-president was Harendra Coomar Mookerjee.
 
• Major appointments of the Constituent Assembly were as follows
 
 
• Temporary President - Sachchidananda Sinha
 
• President - Rajendra Prasad
 
• Vice President - HC Mookerjee and VT Krishnamachari
 
• Chairman of Drafting Committee - BR Ambedkar
 
• Constitutional Advisor - BN Rau​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Assembly met for the first time in New Delhi on 9 December 1946, and its last session was held on 24 January 1950.
 
• Major Committees of Constitution Assembly were
 
 
• Drafting Committee – B. R. Ambedkar
 
• Union Power Committee – Jawaharlal Nehru
 
• Union Constitution Committee – Jawaharlal Nehru
 
• Provincial Constitution Committee – Vallabhbhai Patel
 
• Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Minorities and Tribal and Excluded Areas – Vallabhbhai Patel.
